invariants.rationale: idPfx is typically a required identifier for inserts and should not be null.
recordItr is the main data iterator and must be non-null for the operation to proceed.
recordItr may or may not have elements at method entry; both possibilities are allowed.
idPfx may be empty or non-empty; there is no evidence for a stricter constraint.
At least one of recordItr or idPfx should be non-null for meaningful processing.
